question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Reliable
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Reliable"** means someone or something that can be trusted or depended upon. (भरोसेमंद)
 
 
• **Example: **She is a reliable friend who is always there for you.
 
 
 
• **"Untrustworthy"** refers to someone or something that cannot be trusted or relied upon. (अविश्वसनीय)
 
 
• **Example: **He proved to be untrustworthy when he broke his promise.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unknown** (अज्ञात): Something or someone that is not known.
 
 
• **Example:** The cause of the disease is still unknown.
 
 
 
• **Unfamiliar** (अनजान): Not known or recognized.
 
 
• **Example:** The terrain was unfamiliar to the hikers.
 
 
 
• **Uncommon** (असामान्य): Not occurring often, rare.
 
 
• **Example:** It's uncommon to see such a rare bird in this area.
